heroes.name: Smith
heroes.notes: Starting hero. Growth hero for Iron resources.
heroes.best_use: Iron gathering only. Replace in combat with any Epic or Legendary infantry.

heroes.name: Eugene
heroes.notes: Growth hero for Wood resources.
heroes.best_use: Wood gathering only. Replace in combat with Sergey or any Legendary infantry.

heroes.name: Charlie
heroes.notes: Growth hero for Coal resources.
heroes.best_use: Coal gathering only. Replace in combat with Patrick or any Legendary lancer.

heroes.name: Cloris
heroes.notes: Growth hero for Meat resources. Best hunter on the Icefield.
heroes.best_use: Meat gathering only. Replace in combat with Bahiti or any Legendary marksman.

heroes.name: Sergey
heroes.notes: Best garrison joiner in the game. His expedition skill reduces damage taken by all troops.
heroes.best_use: BEST GARRISON JOINER. Put in leftmost slot when reinforcing garrisons. Don't use for attack rallies.

heroes.name: Gina
heroes.notes: Reduces stamina cost by 20%. Great for Beast Hunting and Polar Terrors.
heroes.best_use: Use for Beast Hunting (stamina savings). Replace in combat with Philly in Gen 2.

heroes.name: Bahiti
heroes.notes: Best Epic marksman. Easy to get shards from Epic Recruitment and Intel Missions.
heroes.best_use: Early game marksman. Great for F2P. Solid until you get Gen 2+ legendary marksmen.

heroes.name: Seo-yoon
heroes.notes: Growth hero with attack and healing buffs. Rally joiner with 25% attack boost for all troops.
heroes.best_use: Early rally joiner with Rallying Beat (+25% troop attack). Good for infirmary healing speed. Replace in combat when better options available.

heroes.name: Jasser
heroes.notes: Growth hero with rally damage boost and research speed. Tactical Genius gives 25% damage to all troops.
heroes.best_use: Early rally joiner/leader with Tactical Genius (+25% troop damage). Also boosts Research Speed by 15%.

heroes.name: Patrick
heroes.notes: Solid early lancer with healing and tankiness. Great F2P hero.
heroes.best_use: Best Epic lancer. Heals troops and boosts survivability. Use until Molly or Flint are leveled.

heroes.name: Ling Xue
heroes.notes: Development hero with attack boosts and training speed. Good defensive buffs when low health.
heroes.best_use: Alternative to Patrick. Training Speed buff useful for building troops.

heroes.name: Lumak Bokan
heroes.notes: Warrior of Emerald Valley. Guerrilla tactics reduce enemy damage. Excellent hunting march speed.
heroes.best_use: BEST FOR HUNTING. 100% hunting march speed at max level.

heroes.name: Jeronimo
heroes.notes: Top tier infantry. 25% troop damage, 25% attack boost. Essential for rallies and SvS.
heroes.best_use: PRIORITY INVESTMENT. Best rally leader. Essential for SvS.

heroes.name: Natalia
heroes.notes: Solid early game infantry. Remains useful across multiple generations.
heroes.best_use: Strong early infantry tank. Good for exploration and as 2nd infantry in rallies.

heroes.name: Molly
heroes.notes: Good lancer for early game exploration. AoE damage with freeze.
heroes.best_use: Early exploration lancer. Good until Flint or Logan.

heroes.name: Zinman
heroes.notes: Growth hero - 15% building cost reduction and faster upgrades. Weak in combat.
heroes.best_use: City development only. Use Building Speed and Bastionist skills.

heroes.name: Flint
heroes.notes: Strong lancer. Good investment to strengthen your team.
heroes.best_use: Top Gen 2 lancer. Great for rallies and SvS. Worth heavy investment until Gordon.

heroes.name: Philly
heroes.notes: Best healer in the game. Essential for exploration. Must-have.
heroes.best_use: MUST HAVE HEALER. Essential for all exploration content.

heroes.name: Alonso
heroes.notes: Great infantry with AOE damage and healing.
heroes.best_use: Excellent infantry with self-sustain. Great for exploration and solid in SvS. Pairs well with Jeronimo.

heroes.name: Logan
heroes.notes: Top defender. Essential for garrisons and defense.
heroes.best_use: BEST DEFENDER. Essential for garrison defense in SvS.

heroes.name: Mia
heroes.notes: Higher damage and better team scaling than earlier marksmen.
heroes.best_use: Best Gen 3 marksman. Strong in exploration and decent in SvS.

heroes.name: Greg
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Heroes, King of Icefield, State of Power, Hero's Mission
heroes.notes: Crowd-control marksman with stuns and AoE damage.
heroes.best_use: Best for Beast Hunting and Frostfire Mine.

heroes.name: Ahmose
heroes.notes: Frontline tank with invulnerability and infantry damage boost.
heroes.best_use: Strong defensive infantry. Good tank for exploration.

heroes.name: Reina
heroes.notes: Silent assassin with AoE damage and dodge.
heroes.best_use: Great assassin kit for Exploration.

heroes.name: Lynn
heroes.notes: Support marksman with debuff cleanse and healing reduction.
heroes.best_use: Best defensive Marksman. Nice debuff/control clearing.

heroes.name: Hector
heroes.notes: Combat infantry with control immunity and damage boost when low health.
heroes.best_use: Excellent for rallies. Strong Infantry/Marksmen damage buffs.

heroes.name: Norah
heroes.notes: Top tier rally joiner. Sneak Strike boosts Lancer damage dramatically.
heroes.best_use: TOP TIER RALLY JOINER. Priority SvS hero.

heroes.name: Gwen
heroes.notes: First Marksman to target backline directly. Massive burst damage.
heroes.best_use: Best offensive Marksman for Exploration.

heroes.name: Jessie
heroes.notes: BEST attack rally joiner in the game. Her Stand of Arms skill (+25% DMG dealt) affects ALL damage types.
heroes.best_use: BEST ATTACK JOINER. Put in leftmost slot when joining attack rallies.

heroes.name: Wu Ming
heroes.notes: Top tier hero. Cyclone Barrier, Shadow Evasion. Excels in all game modes.
heroes.best_use: TOP 3 HERO IN GAME. Priority investment.

heroes.name: Renee
heroes.notes: Powerhouse with invulnerability, area damage, and damage reduction.
heroes.best_use: Excellent lancer with survivability. Great for SvS and rallies.

heroes.name: Wayne
heroes.notes: Solid marksman for Gen 6.
heroes.best_use: Good marksman option. Consider waiting for Blanchette if server age is close.

heroes.name: Gordon
heroes.notes: Top tier for Bear Hunt and rallies. Poison toolkit amplifies Lancer damage.
heroes.best_use: BEST LANCER FOR RALLIES.

heroes.name: Edith
heroes.notes: Mech pilot with Mr. Tin robot. Amazing rally joiner with troop buffs.
heroes.best_use: EXCELLENT RALLY JOINER.

heroes.name: Bradley
heroes.notes: Artillery marksman with powerful AoE.
heroes.best_use: TOP PVE MARKSMAN. Bear Hunt scores increase dramatically.

heroes.name: Gatot
heroes.notes: Heir of kings with shield and intimidation. Really hard to kill.
heroes.best_use: BEST DEFENSIVE INFANTRY. Excellent for garrison defense.

heroes.name: Hendrik
heroes.notes: Naval captain with abyssal spirits. Worm's Ravage reduces enemy defense by 25%.
heroes.best_use: TOP RALLY SUPPORT.

heroes.name: Sonya
heroes.notes: Fallen Queen with ice attacks. Extreme Cold freezes and deals AoE damage.
heroes.best_use: EXCELLENT CONTROL LANCER.

heroes.name: Magnus
heroes.notes: Wild infantry with twin axes. Absolutely wild damage, buffs, and debuffs.
heroes.best_use: TOP TIER INFANTRY. S+ for Gen 9+.

heroes.name: Fred
heroes.notes: Fire lancer with shield and burn effects.
heroes.best_use: Good support lancer. Best in Arena and Expedition.

heroes.name: Xura
heroes.how_to_obtain: King of Icefield, State of Power, Foundry Shop, Daily Deals
heroes.notes: Enigmatic marksman with healing dance and high burst.
heroes.best_use: TOP RALLY LEADER. F2P friendly via Foundry Shop.

heroes.name: Blanchette
heroes.notes: Best damage dealer in the game. High base stats, accurate attacks.
heroes.best_use: BEST MARKSMAN IN GAME. F2P friendly unlock.

heroes.name: Gregory
heroes.notes: Legion of the Sun guardian. Even in death, his example buffs allies.
heroes.best_use: Solid infantry with Sacrificial Will.

heroes.name: Freya
heroes.notes: Night's Vengeance with chains. High burst damage and enemy control.
heroes.best_use: TOP EXPLORATION LANCER.

heroes.name: Eleonora
heroes.how_to_obtain: Lucky Wheel, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Royal infantry with blazing shield. Reflects 30% damage while shielded.
heroes.best_use: Tank with Shield of Blaze.

heroes.name: Lloyd
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Chiefs, King of Icefield, State of Power, Daily Deals, Hero Rally, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Craftsman lancer with mechanical cuckoos and bombs.
heroes.best_use: LETHALITY SPECIALIST.

heroes.name: Rufus
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Heroes, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Rebel mercenary with explosive grenades and burn effects.
heroes.best_use: TOP AOE MARKSMAN.

heroes.name: Hervor
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Heroes, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Chieftain of Sathla with hammer strikes and intimidation.
heroes.best_use: TOP TIER INFANTRY.

heroes.name: Karol
heroes.how_to_obtain: Lucky Wheel, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Eagle Brigade cavalry commander. Dawn Charge with attack buffs.
heroes.best_use: TOP OFFENSIVE LANCER.

heroes.name: Ligeia
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Chiefs, King of Icefield, State of Power, Daily Deals, Hero Rally, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Mech-spider queen with summons and damage reflection.
heroes.best_use: BEST GEN 12 DPS.

heroes.name: Gisela
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Chiefs, King of Icefield, State of Power, Daily Deals, Hero Rally, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Mechanical genius with mech-arms and energy shield system.
heroes.best_use: Defensive infantry with energy-based shield.

heroes.name: Flora
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Heroes, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Botanist summoner with vines, toxic blooms, and plant summons.
heroes.best_use: TOP EXPLORATION LANCER.

heroes.name: Vulcanus
heroes.how_to_obtain: Lucky Wheel, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Undercity hunter with chained darts and terror tactics.
heroes.best_use: TOP RALLY MARKSMAN.

heroes.name: Elif
heroes.how_to_obtain: Lucky Wheel, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Ethereal dancer with high evasion and confusion.
heroes.best_use: TOP EVASION TANK.

heroes.name: Dominic
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Chiefs, King of Icefield, State of Power, Daily Deals, Hero Rally, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Magician with box tricks, fire roses, and unique revival.
heroes.best_use: UNIQUE REVIVAL.

heroes.name: Cara
heroes.how_to_obtain: Hall of Heroes, Mythic General Hero Shard, Foundry Shop
heroes.notes: Steam-powered marksman with cannon and gas attacks.
heroes.best_use: TOP AoE MARKSMAN.

tier_descriptions.S+: Meta-defining. Stays relevant across many generations. Always worth max investment.
tier_descriptions.S: Excellent heroes that define their role. High priority investment.
tier_descriptions.A: Great heroes for their generation. Good investment, but may be replaced later.
tier_descriptions.B: Good heroes. Use if you don't have better options.

Infantry.description: Frontline tanks. High defense and health.

Lancer.description: Balanced fighters. Good damage and mobility.
